title: WPCRL/112/2017 of Smt. Khushboo Tiwari AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPCRL No. 112 of 2017
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal and
Mr. Milind Raj, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. Prem Kaushal, Brief Holder
for the State/respondent nos. 1 to 3.
Vakalatnama filed by Mr. Ashok
Joshi, Advocate on behalf of Shri Dinesh
Chandra is taken on the record.
Heard learned counsels of either
party. Smt. Khushboo Tiwari is also
present in person before the court. The
police protection was granted by this
court on 25.01.2017 to Smt. Khushboo
Tiwari along with her spouse
Shri Naveen Chandra. Now, both are
living separately on account of the
matrimonial discord. So, this
application has been moved by Smt.
Khusboo Tiwari that an order dated
25.01.2017 be recalled lest it is
misused/abused by the estranged
husband Naveen Chandra, who is now
being represented by the counsel Mr.
Milind Raj.
Learned counsel on behalf of the
husband-Naveen Chandra also does not
oppose this application. Therefore, it is
hereby allowed.
Order dated 25.01.2017 is
recalled and this criminal petition also
finally stands disposed of.
